behavior: Immutable native and reconstructed revision history, explicit gaps and closed-project reads
Idempotent update receipts with exact run/thread attribution and optimistic revision conflicts
Bounded revision and linked-message pagination, response limits and race-safe client rendering
Encrypted draft reload replay, close/navigation retention and explicit discard

rollback.hub: Use TrueNAS middleware to restore the prior versioned binary volume, then verify RUNNING, its recorded hash, integrity/FK and authenticated readiness. The new tables are additive; restore the recorded database backup only with the app stopped if state rollback is actually required.
rollback.cli: Atomically restore each host's uniquely named rollback binary after restoring compatible frontend/hub behavior; do not restart relays.
rollback.frontend: Deploy the retained prior package explicitly to Cloudflare project tailos and rsync that exact package to Mini's served directory without changing the listener.

excluded: Tailscale installation, configuration, restart or networking changes
live task/profile fixtures or task closure
limits: The originally reported Bugs-only create/edit failure was not reproduced by the isolated CRUD matrix; this release does not claim a causal repair for that report.

The full old/new/old/new migration matrix belongs to accepted commit d8269f4. The bounded correction at 9ea8653 changed no schema, store migration or receipt semantics and was verified with focused integration/browser checks rather than rerunning that entire matrix.

Cloudflare Web Analytics adds its beacon to browser HTML requests. Raw package verification therefore uses Accept */* to avoid the HTML transform; the actual browser path, including that transform, separately passed the production-WASM and vault smoke.
